data/skills_dataset.csv.message:
Add reproducible analysis suite, static AST scanner, and dynamic sandbox validation

- Offline analysis suite (helper.py analyze) regenerating the dataset and taxonomy numbers from data/
- Phase 2 static detection: regex scanner + tree-sitter AST credential->sink flow + NL description analyzer
- Phase 3 dynamic validation: dual-condition (benign/adversarial) differential in an instrumented Docker sandbox
- Reproduction guide (REPRODUCE.md) and unit tests
